note: Every entry traces to a named finding in the follow-ups doc. layer is 'infra' throughout: this change touches hook-tier enforcement machinery only, no frontend and no runtime API. Playwright criteria are therefore N/A by construction, and dev-API integration criteria are N/A for the same reason; the executable criterion for each entry is a pytest property with a mutation witness.

entries.spec_requirement_id: Blocking is unbounded and released only by a named kill-switch
scenarios: A persistently wedged run emits a notification and keeps blocking
A notifier failure never affects the block
acceptance_criteria: A notification is emitted exactly once when the lock has blocked past its persistence threshold, and the stop is STILL refused on that same evaluation.
No notification is emitted on an ordinary single block.
A notifier that raises, times out, or is absent leaves the exit code and the block message byte-identical to the no-notifier case.
The continuation guard no-progress counter is NOT advanced by the notification path (ADV-1: escalation-pending.md is agent-written and the lock does not honour it).
Both directions pinned; a mutation witness per property reproduces the real defect rather than disturbing nearby code.

entries.spec_requirement_id: The turn-output rule is a one-line-of-state constraint
scenarios: A task subject carrying a forged instruction section renders inert
acceptance_criteria: A task subject containing newlines, a bullet prefix, and a colon-terminated heading imitating the block release section renders as inert single-line content.
The genuine release section appears exactly once in the rendered block.
An ordinary task subject remains readable after clipping.
Mutation witness on the strip.

entries.spec_requirement_id: The completion lock ground truth is immutable to agents
scenarios: A redirected task root does not unprotect the real one
acceptance_criteria: With the task-root override pointing elsewhere, a write to a task file under the REAL default root is still refused.
The configured override root remains protected, so the CT6_TASKS_ROOT test seam keeps working.
The protected set is a union: the override may add a location, never remove the real store.
Tested via a patched home directory; no test reads or writes the user's real task store.
Mutation witness.

entries.spec_requirement_id: The completion lock ground truth is immutable to agents
scenarios: A hardlink under another name is refused
An ordinary unrelated write is allowed
acceptance_criteria: A write to a hardlink pointing at the ask-ledger under a different filename is refused on filesystem-identity grounds.
An ordinary write to an unrelated source file still proceeds — an over-broad guard is a worse defect than the hole.
Identity comparison applies only where both paths exist; a new-file write is unaffected.
An indeterminate identity result falls back to resolved-path comparison; the guard never raises.
If os.link is unavailable on this volume the test skips with a stated reason rather than passing vacuously.
Mutation witness.

entries.spec_requirement_id: The turn-output rule is a one-line-of-state constraint
scenarios: A narrative followed by a one-line sign-off still trips
A one-line marked state update is compliant
acceptance_criteria: A characterization corpus of at least 25 varied turn shapes is captured BEFORE any edit and lands as a permanent test.
Full returned-dict equality across every corpus input, pre-change versus post-change — not merely the boolean.
The load-bearing counter and the reporting-only counter are distinguishable at every call site.
Mutation witness: deliberately swapping the two counters turns the corpus RED; if it does not, that is reported as a finding.
NARRATIVE_ABSOLUTE_LINES and NARRATIVE_LINE_THRESHOLD keep their deliberately different counting (the G3-without-un-fixing-T2 property).

entries.spec_requirement_id: The turn-output rule is a one-line-of-state constraint
scenarios: A narrative followed by a one-line sign-off still trips
acceptance_criteria: A verdict of PERSISTED, NOT PERSISTED, or INDETERMINATE is recorded with evidence.
The search scope is quantified — files, patterns, date range — so a null result is a finding rather than a shrug.
Every apparent hit is classified by record provenance; a tool_result, skill body, self-quoting assistant message, or teammate-message envelope does not count.
The larger continuation-guard sample is checked alongside the lock's own few blocks.
Any durable-state recommendation addresses the note_continuation_block objection (empty in plain sessions; writing it from the lock reintroduces F-F pollution).

entries.spec_requirement_id: Blocking is unbounded and released only by a named kill-switch
scenarios: Ten consecutive no-progress stops in an engaged session still block
acceptance_criteria: The lock-wiring mutation artifact classifies caught/escaped by EXIT CODE, not by parsing the pytest result line.
Each mutation asserts the file actually changed before the tests are run, removing the no-op-logs-green class.
Mutations are re-run for real; prior verdicts are not transcribed under a new header.
Any mutation that flips classification under the stricter method is reported explicitly.
